cards.card_text: On that day their cattle will graze in open pastures, and the oxen and donkeys will eat salted fodder, winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.
cards.verse_text: The oxen and donkeys that work the ground will eat salted fodder, winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.
cards.snippet: The oxen and donkeys that work the ground will eat salted fodder, winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.

cards.card_text: This searing wind is blowing to winnow and sift.
cards.verse_text: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A searing wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift; a wind too strong for that comes from Me.
cards.snippet: …the desert blows toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift; a wind too strong for that comes from Me.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He'll send strangers to winnow Babylon and empty her land, and they'll come against her from EVERY side.
cards.verse_text: I will send strangers to Babylon to winnow her and empty her land; for they will come against her from every side in her day of disaster.
